invented.quote: That shift has no supervisor on site.

invented.quote: He is responsible for the herd, the equipment, and anything that goes wrong until the rest of the crew arrives.

invented.quote: He has also grown well beyond the work he was hired to do.
invented.why: The brief does not specify what work Tomás was originally hired to do.

invented.quote: On his own initiative, Tomás learned our herd management software

invented.quote: Tomás communicates clearly and confidently in spoken English.
